verdict.rationale: Brex marketing claims 'AI-powered automation' (docs-7,8,9) but there's no evidence of a natural-language command interface for the product itself; the one concrete AI experiment (a ChatGPT expense bot) was publicly criticized as hallucinating, non-deterministic, and unreliable for financial use (comm-1,2,4), and community commentary explicitly says Brex 'didn't successfully make the AI pivot' compared to competitors (comm-6).
